title: Li
body: I have been looking for an app where I can log and keep track of chores/habits etc for a WHILE. For some reason most of them suck at giving you a proper overview of your month/year, but Evoday did exactly that. The free version lets you log two habits. I’m so happy with it I went ahead and bought the full version and can log however many habits I want. I’ve tried so many different apps for this and this one beats all of them!
author: jsks alajgsbdkd

title: Nice little app!
body: Great little app with (what seems like) a responsive and dedicated team. Well-designed. Looking forward to being able to mark habits as completed straight from the widget. I’m off to a good 2025 in regards to habits! :)
author: simgust

title: Review
body: The app I have been looking for! Great overview for tracking your progress and habits, highly recommend!
